'''Vamasto Maja''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who was one of the oldest of those lived in the [[Pnakotic Coast village]] on the [[Pnakotic Coast]] on [[Savareen]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> She was the supervisor of rebuilding of the refining plant.<ref name="TOG" /> She was also present when [[Tobias Beckett]]'s [[Beckett's gang|crew]] came to Savareen in [[10 BBY]] to refine [[Coaxium]] that they had stolen from [[Kessel]].<ref name="Dates">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Savareen]] in [[Solo: A Star Wars Story]] to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Savareen in Solo must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref>
